comment: C-first mission for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_WISHING). A fresh neutral Wizard wishes a charged wand of wishing, selects the C-observed inventory letter o through #zap, keeps Luck nonnegative, and supplies a food-ration wish. This exercises the wand NODIR branch, makewish result, consumed charge/discovery state, and source message order. Closest earlier wish-like case v10/rub-magic-lamp enters artifact.c’s genie path; it does not enter zapnodir, consume a wand charge, or use the wand discovery contract.
